description: A semicircular gauge-style pie showing battery share by device, with a caption under the arc.
overview: Uses `PieChart` with one `Pie` drawn from `startAngle={180}` to `endAngle={0}`, centered low with `cy="88%"`, using `innerRadius="105%"` and `outerRadius="150%"`, `paddingAngle={1.5}`, `cornerRadius={4}` and `stroke="none"`. `chartData` holds four `{ device, share, fill }` records that add up to 100, and `chartConfig` defines `share` plus `phone`, `laptop`, `tablet` and `watch` with `var(--blue)`, `var(--teal)`, `var(--indigo)` and `var(--orange)`. An absolutely positioned caption sits under the arc.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your shares and add matching `chartConfig` entries. Because the radii are percentages of the container, adjust `cy`, `innerRadius` and `outerRadius` together if you change the container height. The tooltip `formatter` prints the `chartConfig` label followed by the value with a percent sign; change it for non-percentage values. The caption text is static, so update it with your data.
notes: `accessibilityLayer` is set on `PieChart`, so the chart is focusable and arrow keys move between slices.
